capabilities: Create and publish Zhihu articles from Markdown notes
Create and publish answers to Zhihu questions
Upload local and online images to Zhihu
Browse Zhihu recommendations, followings and hot lists in Obsidian
Insert member mentions and card links with Zhihu syntax
extras: The README states the plugin never uploads user information; several planned features remain on the TODO list (Desmos graphs, comments view, publishing to columns).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes directly to Zhihu, including login, image upload and Zhihu-specific syntax.

relations.evidence: This plugin allows you publish your markdown file directly to Zhihu, a Chinese question-answer platform.
The login feature requires Obsidian core plugin: web viewer, which is disabled by default.

summary: Publishing plugin that creates, edits and publishes Markdown notes as Zhihu articles and answers, and browses Zhihu feeds inside Obsidian.
